title: 100 Pesos (100 Years of the Central Bank of Chile)

composition.text: Bimetallic: nickel brass centre in copper-aluminium-nickel ring (Core: 70% Copper, 15% Nickel, 15% Zinc. Ring: 92% Copper, 6% Aluminium, 2% Nickel)

obverse.description: Features the logo of Banco Central de Chile alongside the phrase “CIEN años” in the center of the core. Above, on the outer ring, appears the legend “REPÚBLICA DE CHILE”. Below, within the core, a stylized mountain represents a simplified depiction of the Andes. At the bottom of the ring, the inscription “BANCO CENTRAL DE CHILE 1925 – 2025” is shown. The mintmark (Ceca).

reverse.description: Displays the Escudo Nacional (National Coat of Arms) at the center of the core. Beneath it are the year 2025, the denomination “100”, and the word “PESOS”, overlapping with the ring. Surrounding the design on the ring are laurel branches.
